title: Pass a sterile device cord off the field to the console
instruction: Plug the sterile white cord into the grey console's jack, with the cord lying in the grey holder's slot. The left arm and the blue drape are sterile, the right arm is not. Let go with both arms at the end.
context: Surgical technologists (O*NET 29-2055.00) "maintain a proper sterile field during surgical procedures". A procedure guide citing AORN guidelines says to secure equipment cables to the sterile field with nonperforating devices, and to set a solution receptacle at the draped table's edge so the unsterile person need not reach across the field. AfPP standards: scrubbed staff keep arms and hands well within the field; non-sterile staff should not lean over it. Tabletop mock-up, no patient.
setup: Station table; cm from the point midway between the arm bases (x forward, y left). Sterile field: box 44x48x5 cm under a blue drape, x 8-52, y 0-48 (right edge on y 0). White holster block 5x3.5x3 cm on it at x 12, y 3.6. White 8 mm cord, 45 cm, 60 g, glued in the holster at x 14, y 6, lies straight at 50 deg to x; black 80x16x14 mm plug, 18 g, centre x 45.5, y 43.5. Hand-off line through x 30, y 0 at -60 deg. Grey PLA holder on it: slot 14 mm wide (two 40x4x30 mm walls, centre x 24.75, y 9.1) and a 110x30x10 mm ledge, top flush with the drape, reaching 8.5 cm past the edge along the line. Grey console 12x16x7.5 cm, centre x 43, y -22.5; its jack sleeve (opening 20x18 mm, 30 mm deep, centre 5.8 cm above the table) faces the holder, face at x 38, y -13.9.
scoring: Score 0 if: the left gripper centre ever crosses the field edge (y < 0) or the right one ever goes over the field (y > 0); the plug ever touches the table; the plug centre is still over the field when the right gripper first comes within 3 cm of it; at the end the cord is not in the holder slot, or a gripper centre is within 4.5 cm of the plug (any point along its length) or 3 cm of the cord. Otherwise: 1.0 = plug tip at least 15 mm inside the jack, lined up with it; 0.3 = plug resting on the ledge with its centre beyond the field edge, not in the jack (left arm's half done); anything else 0.
reset_notes: Lay the cord straight from the holster along its 50 deg tape line with the plug flat at its tape mark (centre x 45.5, y 43.5) on the drape; empty the slot, ledge and jack. Field, holder, console and holster are fixed (clamped/taped); if any is moved, put it back and rerun the trial.
fidelity: Cord: 22 rigid segments (about 2 cm) with bending springs, no twist; plug a rigid box held in the jack by friction (no latch). Field, holder and console are rigid and fixed. Instead of a hand-to-hand pass, the scrub arm sets the plug on the holder ledge at the field edge for the other arm to take. Zones are judged only from each gripper centre (between the fingertips) against the field edge line, not the rest of the arm. No patient, no live electrics.
